user.title: Climate Comfort
user.description: What would you like to set up?

room.title: Room Thermostat
room.description: Create a multi-stage thermostat for one room. Global Defaults must be configured first; modes and profiles are inherited from there. Devices are added after creation via the Configure button.

data_description.temperature_sensor: The sensor whose reading drives all heating and cooling decisions for this room.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional. Only needed if you are adding a dehumidifier device to this room.
data_description.comfort_zone: Base half-width of the dead zone either side of the mode target temperature (±°C). The active profile scales this into the effective comfort zone.
data_description.house_mode_entity: Optional. A select entity whose state chooses the active mode for this room. Valid modes are Away, Sleep, Home, Warmup, and Cooldown. The House Mode entity created by the Global Defaults entry works here.
data_description.manual_hold_hours: When any controlled device is changed by someone other than this integration, automated control of that device is suspended for this many hours. 0 = disabled.

global_defaults.title: Global Defaults
global_defaults.description: Required shared configuration for all rooms. Define fixed modes, fixed profiles, safety limits, and optional floor selectors. A House Mode selector is created automatically.

data_description.comfort_zone: Base half-width of the dead zone (±°C). New rooms start with this value; the active profile scales it.
data_description.default_profile: Fallback response profile used when a mode does not specify one.
data_description.minimum_temperature: Global lower safety limit. If a room falls below this, emergency-enabled heating devices may activate regardless of normal staging.
data_description.maximum_temperature: Global upper safety limit. If a room rises above this, emergency-enabled cooling devices may activate regardless of normal staging.
data_description.mode_away: Saved target temperature for Away mode.
data_description.mode_sleep: Saved target temperature for Sleep mode.
data_description.mode_home: Saved target temperature for Home mode.
data_description.mode_warmup: Saved target temperature for Warmup mode.
data_description.mode_cooldown: Saved target temperature for Cooldown mode.
data_description.mode_away_profile: Response profile to use in Away mode.
data_description.mode_sleep_profile: Response profile to use in Sleep mode.
data_description.mode_home_profile: Response profile to use in Home mode.
data_description.mode_warmup_profile: Response profile to use in Warmup mode.
data_description.mode_cooldown_profile: Response profile to use in Cooldown mode.
data_description.profile_relaxed_comfort_multiplier: Scales the base comfort zone for the Relaxed profile. Higher values allow more drift.
data_description.profile_relaxed_point_spacing: How many °C each device activation point represents in the Relaxed profile.
data_description.profile_balanced_comfort_multiplier: Scales the base comfort zone for the Balanced profile.
data_description.profile_balanced_point_spacing: How many °C each device activation point represents in the Balanced profile.
data_description.profile_responsive_comfort_multiplier: Scales the base comfort zone for the Responsive profile. Lower values hold the room closer to target.
data_description.profile_responsive_point_spacing: How many °C each device activation point represents in the Responsive profile.
data_description.profile_aggressive_comfort_multiplier: Scales the base comfort zone for the Aggressive profile. Lower values make the system respond sooner.
data_description.profile_aggressive_point_spacing: How many °C each device activation point represents in the Aggressive profile. Lower values make stages closer together.
data_description.floor_names: Each entry creates a mode selector on the Global Settings device, such as Ground Floor or First Floor. Rooms choose which selector to follow via their house / floor mode entity setting.

abort.global_already_configured: Global defaults already exist — edit them via the Configure button.
abort.global_defaults_required: Create Global Defaults before adding rooms. Modes, profiles, and safety limits are required shared setup.
abort.already_configured: A room with this name already exists. Use a different name or edit the existing room.

data_description.label: A short descriptive name shown on the device page, e.g. Radiator, AirCon, or Dehumidifier.
data_description.entity_id: The switch, climate, or fan entity this controller will turn on and off.
data_description.role: Heating activates when the room is too cold. Cooling activates when the room is too hot. Dehumidify activates from humidity logic, independent of temperature activation points.

data_description.label: A short descriptive name shown on the device page.
data_description.entity_id: The switch, climate, or fan entity this controller will turn on and off.
data_description.role: Heating activates when the room is too cold. Cooling activates when the room is too hot. Dehumidify activates from humidity logic.

data_description.activation_point: Where this device joins in after the room leaves the comfort zone. Heating devices choose -5 to 0; cooling devices choose 0 to 5. The active profile controls how many degrees each point represents.
data_description.deactivate_offset: How far the temperature must recover past the activation point before this device turns off. Prevents rapid on/off cycling.
data_description.emergency_enabled: When enabled, this device may be used if the room crosses the global minimum or maximum temperature safety limit.

data.dehumidify_only_when_idle: Only run when not heating or cooling

data_description.humidity_threshold: The relative humidity level at which this device switches on.
data_description.humidity_hysteresis: Humidity must drop this many percent below the threshold before the device switches off.
data_description.dehumidify_only_when_idle: When on, dehumidification is suppressed while heating or cooling is active.

data_description.hvac_mode_on: The mode set on this climate entity when the controller activates it. The list is populated from the device's own supported modes.
data_description.target_temp_offset: Optional offset to ensure the device actually runs rather than sitting idle because its previous setpoint was already satisfied. Heating devices target setpoint + offset. Cooling devices target setpoint − offset. Set to 0 to target exactly the room setpoint.

edit_settings.title: Room Settings
edit_settings.description: Sensor and zone settings for this room. Modes and profiles are inherited from Global Defaults. {global_summary}

data_description.temperature_sensor: Drives all heating and cooling decisions for this room.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional. Required only if a dehumidify device is configured for this room.
data_description.comfort_zone: Base comfort zone width (±°C). The active profile scales this to create the effective comfort zone.
data_description.house_mode_entity: Optional. A select entity whose state chooses the active mode for this room. Valid modes are Away, Sleep, Home, Warmup, and Cooldown.
data_description.manual_hold_hours: When any controlled device is changed manually or by another automation, automated control of that device is suspended for this many hours. 0 = disabled.

edit_global_defaults.title: Global Defaults
edit_global_defaults.description: Shared modes, profiles, and safety limits used by all rooms.

data_description.comfort_zone: Base comfort zone width (±°C). New rooms start with this value; profiles scale it.
data_description.default_profile: Fallback response profile used when needed.
data_description.minimum_temperature: Lower safety limit. Emergency-enabled heating devices may activate below this temperature.
data_description.maximum_temperature: Upper safety limit. Emergency-enabled cooling devices may activate above this temperature.
data_description.floor_names: Creates extra mode selectors for floors or zones.
